title: Agent Registry
description: Schema for /.well-known/agents.json registry files. Both single-agent and multi-agent domains use this format.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the registry format for forward compatibility. Defaults to '1' if absent.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last registry update

agents.description: Map of agent names to their descriptor URLs or descriptor entry objects. Simple form: 'name': 'https://example.com/agent.json'. Rich form: 'name': { 'url': '...', 'status': '...', 'version': '...' }.

oneOf.description: Direct HTTPS URL to the agent's descriptor

propertyNames.description: Agent names SHOULD use URL-safe ASCII characters (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore)
